MESSAGE: Hello! I am a former slave who got freed!
I was enslaved at 11 years old, in Africa...
During my time as a slave, I was renamed Gustavus Vassa, before getting freed!
I wrote a book called "The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano" about how horrible slaves' lifestyles are!
I am one of the first traders, along with Antonio Goncalves!
I am one of the main abolitionists of the Transatlantic Slave Trade!
